adjudicatedDefects.rootCauseTrace: During T6_gate_v2_repair, stock-reusable-parts auto-replayed its saved T3 helper (search -> primary-review) through step 4 and stopped at step 5 when the v1 gate button (#gate-v1-btn) matched 0 locators on the drifted v2 gate screen (helperStoppedEarly = true, refusalCode = null). browser/workspace/qualification/multi-site-scaling.js then unconditionally called task.verify(page, ...) while still on the gate_v2 page before falling back to the planner. Inside verifyPrimary (multi-site-scaling-site.js), three sequential Playwright page.locator('#rev-...').textContent().catch(() => null) calls each waited for Playwright's default 30,000 ms action timeout (3 x 30.0 s = 90.0 s per site).
adjudicatedDefects.fixApplied: Guarded auto-replay verification with !helperStoppedEarly in multi-site-scaling.js so an incomplete helper stop falls back to the planner immediately without running terminal review locators on an intermediate screen, and switched multi-site-scaling-site.js verifiers to immediate synchronous DOM state reads via page.evaluate.

adjudicatedDefects.rootCauseTrace: On T3 (held-out A -> C composition), scriptedStockDecision in multi-site-scaling.js re-executed A -> B via raw click/fill steps before calling hBC, skipping the hAB helper it had already saved on T1. Stock also lacked the persistentNotes (save_note) tool present in overlapping-requests-reuse.js.
adjudicatedDefects.fixApplied: Updated scriptedStockDecision to invoke call_helper(hAB) at entry on T3 followed by call_helper(hBC) at the intermediate form, and added persistentNotes / save_note parity.

Replaced the uniform template in multi-site-scaling-site.js with four structurally distinct site architectures: procurement (2-field input[type=search]+select search, 2-field input[type=text]+select detail, dl review), helpdesk (1-field search, 3-field input+select+textarea triage, section review), inventory (1-field barcode lookup, 3-field transfer form, table review), and compliance (select-first filter + keyword, 2-field select+textarea, article review), yielding distinct step counts across sites.

adjudicatedDefects.rootCauseTrace: config/fawn-workspace-service.json set dispatch.valueSettleMs to 300 with completionPollMs = 10, causing WorkspaceService.#awaitValue to execute ~30 sequential timer + probe.element IPC roundtrips (~395 ms) on every fill and select action (~15.0 s across 38 fill/select actions in R1..R7).
adjudicatedDefects.fixApplied: Tightened dispatch.valueSettleMs to 40 ms with a 2-step bounded settle check ([20 ms, 20 ms]) in browser/workspace/src/service.js, eliminated duplicate probeUrl IPC in #checkLiveDispatch, added per-action dispatchProfileMs timestamps in ACTION_OUTCOME evidence, and verified real-Chromium hydration-reset detection in choice-controls.test.js and uploads.test.js across Playwright and CDP adapters.
